title: Cinematic Story Studio contract definitions
description: Version 1 shared domain, runtime-agent, approval, and render contracts.

message.description: A redacted operator-safe message; never include manuscript text or secrets.

storageKey.description: An application-owned opaque locator, never an absolute user path.

sourceBytes.description: Authenticated local-service source request ceiling enforced before parser execution.

previewCodePoints.description: Maximum Import Review preview length; canonical extracted text is stored separately.

archiveMemberNameCodePoints.description: Maximum Unicode-code-point length of a validated package-relative member name.

parserDeadlineMs.description: Parent-enforced wall-clock deadline for one spawned parser attempt, including its ownership handshake.

parserProcessMemoryBytes.description: Windows Job Object per-process memory ceiling for the parser launcher and actual parser target.

member.description: A validated package-relative member name, never a user filesystem path.

start.description: Inclusive Unicode-code-point offset into canonical text.

end.description: Exclusive Unicode-code-point offset into canonical text.

message.description: Stable operator-safe text without manuscript excerpts, secrets, or absolute paths.

durationMs.description: Measured child-parser duration. The parent rejects a result whose duration exceeds the configured hard wall-clock deadline.

summary.description: Derived metadata only; never replaces the source span.
